Checkout Service Specification

This document specifies the checkout behaviour for the storefront. It is the authoritative functional contract for the order-placement flow.

1. Cart Invariants

The cart MUST satisfy the following invariants at all times:

  • A cart line quantity is always strictly positive.
  • The cart total equals the sum of line.qty * line.unit_price.
  • An empty cart cannot be checked out.

2. Place-Order Workflow

  1. Validate the cart is non-empty.
  2. Reserve stock for every line.
  3. Authorise payment for the cart total.
  4. On success, emit OrderPlaced; on decline, emit PaymentDeclined.
